'''Ke Len''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Blood Carver]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slave]].

==Biography==
Ke Len belonged to [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Phylus Mon]]. Along with [[Ku-Kak]], [[Mischa Vorfren]] and other slaves, Ke Len was a part of Phylus Mon's security entourage. Lacking any [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], Ke Len was a gunner, protecting Phylus Mon with a [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]]. In close combat, she would maneuver to stealthily attack with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] or a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]].

Like all of Phylus Mon's slaves, Ke Len had an inserted explosive that would [[Death/Legends|kill]] her should Phylus Mon die for any reason. Ke Len knew that the explosive in her chest could be deactivated if hit by an ion weapon, but Phylus Mon did not allow any ion weapon in his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Animiasma]]''. Ke Len hated Phylus Mon, but did not dare to turn against him.

In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[A Mon Alone]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the ''Animiasma'' traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] as a part of Phylus Mon's plan to repair the damaged [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] known as the [[Darkstaff]]. Phylus Mon was analyzing the Staff when it suddenly disappeared. Seconds later, a team opposed to Phylus Mon's interests burst in the throne room. At her master's signal, Ke Len tried to barrage the enemies.
